doc=cdp('DOM.getDocument', depth=-1)
def nid(sel):
    r=cdp('DOM.querySelector', nodeId=doc['root']['nodeId'], selector=sel)['nodeId']
    return cdp('DOM.describeNode', nodeId=r)['node']['backendNodeId']
def fill(sel, text, clear=True):
    n=nid(sel)
    cdp('DOM.focus', backendNodeId=n)
    if clear:
        cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='rawKeyDown', key='a', code='KeyA', commands=['selectAll'])
        cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='keyUp', key='a', code='KeyA')
        press_key('Backspace')
    type_text(text)
